title: Commerce lists: loading and errors
summary: Loading and a failed load for Commerce's three lists, as licenses.list-states draws them: skeleton rows at the real 56px row height under the real column heads in the one workbench, and a failure inside the table that says what failed and keeps the filters, with Retry.
compare: Loading: nothing for 150 ms, then skeleton rows at 56px under the real heads; the search band stays usable; a status message for screen readers (admin-3-22).
A failed load is in the table body, not a toast: what failed (504) and Retry, with the filter chip still on; the band and the heads stay.
The same shapes as licenses.list-states, in the Commerce green context; no shimmer that reads as progress.
Phone: each frame stacks; skeleton rows keep the stacked row shape.
